## Highlights

- **Zero-Dependency Fail-Closed Native Session Skill Reuse (`sessionReuse: true`):** Verifies live `ctx.session.context()` (up to 1,000 recent messages, SHA-256 `contentHash`, 5s clock tolerance + `messageID` matching) to avoid re-attaching already-present native skills on follow-up turns; fails closed immediately on `session.compaction.started`/`ended`, `session.deleted`, `skill.updated`, `plugin.updated`, source edits, or lookup errors. Exposes `sessionReuse` and `reuse: { events, bytes }` in `lazy_skill_status`.
- **Ranking & Prompt Hardening:** Post-coverage `+40` `exactId` bonus, IDF-prioritized `MAX_QUERY_TERMS = 64` for long prompts, `sharedIdentityPrefix` dampening (`0.15x`) for ubiquitous catalog prefixes, expanded EN/TR stopwords, >150-token single-word `negativeTriggerMatch`, and negated (`-skill:id`) / quoted (`"skill:id"`) prose guards.
- **Filesystem & Vault Hardening:** `boundedOpen()` and `readSidecarSync()` now enforce `lstat` pre-gate + `O_NONBLOCK` + `fstat` `dev`/`ino` verification + Linux `/proc/self/fd` canonical containment + 2s `.unref()` read deadline; `parseFrontmatter()` uses first-key-wins with `DUPLICATE_FRONTMATTER_KEY` diagnostics; `scanVaults()` streams via `opendir` with `SKILL.md` budget pinning; `listResourcesWithDiagnostics()` bounds traversal (`2,000` entries / `1s`).
- **Complete Docs & Runnable Examples:** Overhauled `README.md` covering all 37 verified `configure()` options (including `semantic.model`, `rules`, `weights`, `exclude`, `agents`, and sidecar metadata) and bundled 6 validated templates in `examples/`.

## Verification
- `npm run check`: **229 / 229** tests passing across 19 suites, `46 / 46` JS modules syntax, `0` strict TypeScript errors (`@opencode/plugin@2.4.1`).
- `npm audit --omit=dev --omit=optional --audit-level=high`: **0** vulnerabilities (`0` runtime dependencies).
- `npm pack --dry-run`: 57 files, 105.8 kB tarball.

## What's Changed

### Security Hardening
- **`projectAutoBind: false` & `meshProfile.allowedSkills` enforcement on mixed `requiredSkills` + explicit `skill:<id>` turns (`src/plugin.ts`):** Prevent untrusted project vault skills or out-of-role skills mentioned in prompt text from bypassing policy when `requiredSkills` is also present (`source: "task"`), in both `session.hook("prompt")` and `lazy_skill_plan`. Normalize `plan.source` to `"none"` when post-filtering empties `plan.ids`.
- **Post-open `fstatSync(fd)` TOCTOU guard (`src/core/scanner.ts`):** Validate regular-file type and `maxBytes` directly on the opened file descriptor in `readSidecarSync()`.

### Concurrency & Cache Consistency
- **`HostSkillPolicy` generation guard (`src/core/host-policy.ts`):** Prevent stale pre-`clear()` in-flight `ctx.agent.list()` resolutions from overwriting newer permission rosters or clobbering concurrent pending calls.
- **`Catalog.refresh()` invalidation guard (`src/core/catalog.ts`):** Prevent mid-flight `skill.updated` / `plugin.updated` invalidations from being masked by a stale 30s TTL cache.

### Plan/Status Parity & Hygiene
- Expose `bindReason: "binding_owned_by_peer"`, `bindingOwner`, and `baselineMode` in `lazy_skill_plan` (`PLAN_OUTPUT_SCHEMA`), and `baselineMode` in `lazy_skill_status` (`STATUS_OUTPUT_SCHEMA`).
- Call `.unref?.()` on bounded timeout timers across `plugin.ts`, `host-policy.ts`, `semantic.ts`, and `tui.tsx`; align `README.md` TUI default view docs (`Expanded View (Default)`).

### Verification
- `npm run check`: `typecheck:strict` (0 errors on `@opencode/plugin@2.4.1`), `43 / 43` JS syntax checks, **`217 / 217`** tests passing across 17 suites (`tests/deep-audit-fixes.test.js`), `0` vulnerabilities (`npm audit`).

## What's New in v1.7.1

- **Idle Performance & Zero-Waste Polling (`src/core/catalog.ts`, `src/tui.tsx`):**
  - Fingerprints sorted catalog entries (`catalogFingerprint`) in `Catalog.refresh()` so non-forced TTL refreshes with unchanged skills reuse the existing `SearchIndex` and skip redundant BM25F rebuilds and `version` increments (while forced refreshes and real skill edits rebuild immediately).
  - Replaces the fixed 5s `setInterval` in `LazySidebar` (`src/tui.tsx`) with an adaptive `schedulePoll()` (`5s` only while connecting, **`30s`** once connected; `plugin.updated`, `skill.updated`, and session switches still trigger immediate refresh) and adds `sameSnapshot()` shallow equality before `setSnapshot()` to eliminate redundant SolidJS TUI re-renders.
- **Verification:**
  - Adds idle-performance regression tests in `tests/tui-rpc.test.js` — **212 / 212** passing tests across 16 suites, **42 / 42** JS modules, **0** strict TypeScript errors against `@opencode/plugin@2.4.1`, **0** prod audit vulnerabilities.

## What's New in v1.7.0

- **Adaptive Role Baseline Binding (`baselineMode`) (`src/core/config.ts`, `src/core/selection.ts`, `src/plugin.ts`):**
  - Adds `baselineMode: "adaptive" | "always" | "fallback"` (default `"adaptive"`) and `resolveBaselineMode()`.
  - Under `"adaptive"`, standalone and non-orchestrated setups preserve legacy `"fallback"` (either-or: lexical router wins, else `role.default`), while mesh-managed profiles (`bindingOwner: "self" | "external"` or `managedBy: "opencode-hi"`) resolve to `"always"`: safe non-project `role.default` baseline skills bind first (enforcing `candidateIds`, `hostAllowed`, `role.allowed`, and `negativeTriggers`) and lexical/semantic routing fills remaining slots up to `maxActive`.
- **Explicit Mesh Binding Ownership (`bindingOwner`) (`src/bridge.ts`, `src/plugin.ts`):**
  - Adds `MeshAgentProfile.bindingOwner?: "self" | "external"` to `src/bridge.ts`.
  - `"self"` suppresses Lazy automatic binding (even under `autoBind: "all"`) while honoring explicit `skill:<id>` and `requiredSkills`; `"external"` permits Lazy automatic binding; unknown values are safely ignored.
- **Verification:**
  - Adds `tests/baseline-mode.test.js` (11 unit & mesh tests) — **210 / 210** passing tests across 16 suites, **42 / 42** JS modules, **0** strict TypeScript errors against `@opencode/plugin@2.4.1`, **0** prod audit vulnerabilities.

## What's Fixed in v1.6.1

- **OpenCode v2.4.x Tool `output` Schema Contract (`src/plugin.ts`):**
  - Adds explicit JSON Schema `output` definitions (`SEARCH_OUTPUT_SCHEMA`, `INFO_OUTPUT_SCHEMA`, `PLAN_OUTPUT_SCHEMA`, `STATUS_OUTPUT_SCHEMA`, `LOAD_OUTPUT_SCHEMA`, `RESOURCE_OUTPUT_SCHEMA`) to all 6 `lazy_skill_*` tool registrations so OpenCode `v2.4.1` host `outputSchema` validation accepts structured `{ content, output }` responses in both standalone and multi-plugin setups.
  - Returns consistent schema-compliant `output` across every branch of `lazy_skill_load` (`{ id, scope, loaded, base }` on vault load) and `lazy_skill_resource` (`{ id, path, bytes }`).
- **Verification:**
  - Adds `tests/tool-output-schema.test.js` validating all 6 tools and every return branch against their declared JSON Schemas (**199 / 199** passing tests, **41 / 41** JS modules, **0** strict typecheck errors, **0** prod vulnerabilities).
  - Verified live inside an isolated `opencode v2.4.1 --standalone` host across all 6 `lazy_skill_*` tools (`hasOutputSchema: true`, `ok: true`).
